SECURITIES AND EXCHANGE BOARD OF INDIA
Most Important Terms and Conditions (MITC) for Investment Advisers
SEBI/HO/MIRSD/MIRSD-PoD/P/CIR/2025/19 dated February 17, 2025

1. Every investment adviser shall provide each client the standardized Most Important Terms
and Conditions (MITC) specified by the Board.

2. The client agreement shall incorporate the standardized MITC, and the investment adviser
must obtain the client's acknowledgement of having received and understood them.

3. Existing clients shall be informed of the standardized MITC on or before June 30, 2025.
